name: OpenHunts

sources.title: Pricing — Free (20 slots/wk, ~60-week queue or badge skip), Premium $19, Highlight demand-priced

conditions: Free Launch: 20 slots weekly and a stated queue time of ~60 weeks — OR add the OpenHunts badge to skip the queue (badge-verification shortcut documented in their blog)
Free tier dofollow backlink only if the launch finishes top 3; Twitter/newsletter shoutout only if #1
requirements: Account required: Google, GitHub, or email sign-in before /projects/submit
Weekly launch format: all launches go live Monday 8:00 AM UTC, featured on homepage for 7 days
preparation: Badge embedded if using the free queue-skip

Plan choice: Free $0 / Premium $19 per launch (skip wait, choose week, guaranteed dofollow, no badge) / Highlight $20–$59 per week demand-priced (instant launch, highlighted in feed, NEW ARRIVAL carousel, guaranteed shoutout)
workflow: Free: join the queue or verify the badge to skip; Premium/Highlight: pay and pick/confirm the launch week
Launch Monday 8:00 AM UTC; community voting determines top-3/#1 outcomes
watchFor: ~60-week free queue is effectively a pay-or-badge wall — the badge is the only zero-cost accelerator
Prices shown with strike-throughs ($9.9→$19 Premium; $20→$59 Highlight 'demand-based rates') — actual charge is what checkout shows
Premium does NOT include the NEW ARRIVAL carousel — that's Highlight-only
One launch per scheduling choice; only top-3 gets amplified
countsAsLive: Project live on the OpenHunts homepage/trending for its 7-day window starting Monday 8:00 AM UTC, with its AI/GEO-optimized detail page public
unknowns: Exact badge markup and verification mechanics
Whether free-queue submissions still get a nofollow listing immediately or wait the full ~60 weeks
